name: jumphp/physics
description: A small 2D physics engine for JumPHP: balls, rings and arcs (rotating, opening, growing, shrinking, with gaps), pegs, walls; gravity, restitution, collision events; fixed step, seeded, 32-bit safe

physics.doc: Physics: gravity (px/s², down), restitution (1 = no energy lost), hz = steps a second (fixed), seed (same seed, same run)
